proof_roadmap.step: Graph factorization inside the product of smooth charts.

difficulty_reason: For immersions i : U -> P and i' : U -> P' over S with P, P' smooth over S and a point u of U, the lemma proves the equivalence of i being Koszul-regular near u and i' being Koszul-regular near u — the key independence step showing the Koszul-regularity notion attached to locally closed embeddings into smooth S-schemes is well defined. The retained proof is written (only one direction, the other being symmetric): the diagonal-type map j = (i, i') : U -> P x_S P' = P'' composed with the smooth projection P'' -> P is i; Divisors, lemma lift-regular-immersion-to-smooth upgrades i Koszul-regular to j Koszul-regular along the smooth projection, and Divisors, lemma push-regular-immersion-thru-smooth descends Koszul-regularity from j to i' = p_2 o j since P'' -> P' is again smooth. Retained author proof at lines 18083-18091.

dedup.scope: Independence of the Koszul-regularity test from the smooth compactification of the immersion.
